headline: Davis & Elkins win at Charleston to stay unbeaten
dek: A single goal at Charleston gave Davis & Elkins their eighth win of the season and handed the hosts a first conference defeat. They have now gone nine matches without losing, and Concord, who beat Frostburg State the same evening, sit a point behind them.
displaced_by: Davis & Elkins won the top-two meeting at Charleston, Charleston's first conference defeat

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Charleston have scored more goals than West Liberty and Point Park together, and twelve different players have shared their twenty-eight; the scoring is spread, not carried.

wire.line: Only Davis & Elkins have avoided defeat; every other side in the conference, Concord included, has now lost at least once.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Davis & Elkins have won eight of their nine matches and conceded six goals in them.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Charleston have lost twice in ten matches, both times at home, and have conceded seven goals all season.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Concord have conceded six goals in ten matches, and won seven of them.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: West Virginia Wesleyan are without a win after nine matches, with one draw and eight defeats, and have conceded thirty-one goals.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Frank Stare has six goals and three assists for Frostburg State from twenty-one shots.

last_match.line: Charleston had not conceded a conference goal since beating Concord in September; it was also the only match this season in which they have failed to score.

next_match.line: Concord's only conference defeat came at Charleston; Davis & Elkins have won every conference match since drawing at Frostburg State on the opening day.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
